items.title: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
items.description: The new levies would hit many of America's biggest trading partners, including China and the EU.

items.title: Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater
items.description: The asteroid's surface was transformed after a spacecraft was deliberately crashed into it four years ago

items.title: Israeli judges recommend dropping most serious charges against Netanyahu
items.description: The Israeli PM says his trial should end after judges said there was little chance of conviction in one of three cases.

items.title: US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify
items.description: All three main US indexes were down in early trading, with the tech-dominated Nasdaq down almost 4%.

items.title: My family were killed in Ukraine. My mum blamed Zelensky's troops - the truth is complicated
items.description: BBC journalist Anastasiya Gribanova investigates who killed her father and grandparents in the war.

items.title: US Army says controlled blast of explosives in Iowa was 'huge success'
items.description: Despite widespread concern from residents ahead of the blast, officials say that lead readings in the area so far have been promising.

items.title: North Korea expels Swiss diplomat in sanctions row
items.description: Swiss officials said relations would be kept through North Korea's embassy in Bern, and its own embassy in Beijing.
